interpretation.themeGeometry: All construction below is theme-invariant by board law.

lightTreatment.kira: Use Kira light tokens; cyan is hairline/state with no persistent glow.
lightTreatment.mochi: Use Mochi light tokens; rose is state and gold is hairline/rim.
lightTreatment.atlas: Use Atlas light tokens; cobalt is drawn linework.

darkTreatment.kira: Use Kira dark tokens; the same cyan lines may emit a restrained cyan glow.
darkTreatment.mochi: Use Mochi dark tokens; the same rose/gold geometry may gain restrained candlelit warmth.
darkTreatment.atlas: Use Atlas dark tokens; the same cobalt lines may emit a restrained holographic glow.

interpretation.anatomyPolicy: Preserve current shadcn anatomy and prop APIs. This file specifies visual construction only.
interpretation.extendedSetPolicy: The 34 Extended Set mappings below are documentation for review only. Light and dark boards have identical construction; theme tokens alone change. POWER remains excluded from every workhorse component.
interpretation.honestyPolicy: When a board declares NO MOTIF FIT, motifIds is empty and carrier states exactly: no artifact claims this, geometry only.

kira.geometry: Unframed stack divided by 1px traces; hairpin rotates −90° to 0° in 120ms and turns accent only when open.

mochi.geometry: Unframed stack with gold open-item rule and neutral closed-item rule; crescent rotates 90° over 250ms.
mochi.carrier: Item rules carry ribbon; disclosure indicator carries crescent.

atlas.geometry: Unframed stack divided by 1px bands; one bracket corner rotates 90° in 180ms linear and turns cobalt when open.
atlas.carrier: Disclosure indicator carries panel bracket; item rules carry strap/band.

kira.geometry: Hairpin points right when closed and down when open; revealed content hangs from a 1px vertical trace.
kira.carrier: Disclosure indicator carries hairpin; depth guide carries circuit.

mochi.geometry: Crescent is the sole disclosure affordance; revealed content hangs from a 1.2px quadratic depth curve.
mochi.carrier: Disclosure indicator carries crescent; depth guide carries drape.

atlas.geometry: Bracket corner points right when closed and down when open; revealed content hangs from a 2px structural band.
atlas.carrier: Disclosure indicator carries panel bracket; depth guide carries strap/band.

mochi.geometry: Ordinary 1px border or consequential gold rule at 55%; labelled variant may break for a pearl or mono caption at 0.12em.
mochi.carrier: The divider carries ribbon; the optional label marker carries pearl.

atlas.geometry: Ordinary 1px division or 2px structural band; labelled variant may break for a survey diamond or mono caption at 0.12em.
atlas.carrier: The divider carries strap/band; the optional label marker carries grid/diamond.

mochi.geometry: Single group with 10px outer corners, square interior joints and gold hairline seams; selected segment lifts to elevated fill.

atlas.carrier: The group shell and segment plates carry buckle/frame.

mochi.geometry: Approved static-empty assembly: hanging crescent with descending sparkles over 2.4s; centred 13px muted copy and action no taller than 32px.

atlas.geometry: Approved static-empty assembly: dormant survey grid with one station pulsing over 2.4s; centred 13px muted copy and action no taller than 32px.

kira.name: Trace focus
kira.construction: A 1px cyan perimeter line traces for 240ms then resolves to the collar ring plus descending circuit stem.
kira.specimenLoop: kiratrace 2.2s linear infinite is demonstration-only; production focus transition duration is 240ms.

themeBehavior.dark: same line and geometry with restrained cyan emission

mochi.name: Bloom focus
mochi.construction: A localized soft radial rose wash extends 18px from the control, rises from the interaction point, and settles; the button retains a 2px surface separation plus 1.5px rose ring.
mochi.specimenLoop: mochibloom 2.6s ease-in-out infinite is demonstration-only; production feedback must settle rather than loop indefinitely.

themeBehavior.dark: same geometry with candlelit rose and gold glow

atlas.name: Dock focus
atlas.construction: Four 10×10, 2px cobalt panel brackets begin 8px outside the control, converge, and seat in 180ms.
atlas.specimenLoop: atlasdock 2s ease-in-out infinite is demonstration-only; production docking duration is 180ms.

themeBehavior.dark: same brackets with restrained holographic emission
